issue.title: Type defenition of ctx.scene.state
issue.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
I want to use state of scene to save data, but because it originally typed as object typescript 
does not allow this.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
It would be great to be able to set the type of state. For example pass an iterface to Telegraf or Stage

comments.body:
> Not clear. Could you please explain more detailed about what do you mean to save data?

Any data. Because state is declared as object, you will get error every time you will try to set anything in it.

`ctx.scenes.state.name = "Nazar",  // Property name does not exists on type object`
`state` property in  both `ctx.scene.state`  and `ctx.wizard.state` still has typing of an `object` and there is no possibility to override with generic.
I think that's true, IIRC the changes had been reverted before the merge because the types were too complex. I won't work on this myself, but PRs are welcome!
Did anyone volunteer to work on this yet?

> MySessionData

This is a session 
Not a wizard state

> > MySessionData
> 
> This is a session Not a wizard state
what's the difference? 

I am just using session state as wizard / base scene state. If you leave a scene - its reset anyways, if you switch scene - you can preserve it

> Can't see how the patch is complex. Works with 4.9.2

It's been 3 years since and I'm still applying this patch  https://github.com/telegraf/telegraf/issues/894#issuecomment-1253828790 and works just like needed

Partially addressed in #2092 via commit 327d7d37: scene state now infers from custom scene session data (`SceneSessionData["state"]`) and the behavior is covered by a TypeScript compile test.

Tracking PR: https://github.com/telegraf/telegraf/pull/2092
